theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.68%) and Technology (+1.38%) led the market today, while Utilities (-2.11%) and Real Estate (-1.12%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.13% versus -1.08% for defensives and -0.46% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.11% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.07%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.25%. The VIX fell 7.71% to 18.44, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 1.17% to $4,152.10, crude oil was little changed at $98.24, and bitcoin slipped 0.02% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
